# device-enrolment

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from services/device-enrolment/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/device-enrolment.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `device-enrolment` component of `services/device-enrolment`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.enrolment`: generated from its catalogue, [device-enrolment.json](../../services/device-enrolment/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/device-enrolment.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `DEVICE_ENROLMENT` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ENROLMENT_ISSUER` | Unset | This service's entity id: the attestations' iss and the key proofs' aud | **Doesn't start**: Unset: the service does not start, naming it | Any | Yes |
| `PORT` | `8080`; a whole number, 0 to 65535 | The port the service listens on | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number, or not a port: the service does not start | Any | No |
| `REGISTRY` | `iom`; one of `iom`, `memory` | Where enrolments live: iom, the Identity Object Model directory, or memory, this process only, lost on restart, with a warning | **Not checked**: Anything but memory, in any case, means iom | In production only as accepted risk `in-memory-state`: `memory` | No |
| `IDM_DATABASE_URL` | Unset; a secret, never shown | The Identity Object Model directory (Postgres) the registry lives in, as a JDBC URL or a postgresql:// DSN; not read with REGISTRY=memory. It wins over DATABASE_URL, which is never used | **Doesn't start**: Unset: the service does not start, naming it; a URL that is neither jdbc: nor postgres: is refused | Any | Yes |
| `DATABASE_URL` | Unset; a secret, never shown | Read only to refuse it: the registry's database before it moved to the Identity Object Model. Set while IDM_DATABASE_URL is unset, the service does not start and names the rename; with IDM_DATABASE_URL set it is ignored | **Doesn't start**: Set without IDM_DATABASE_URL: the service does not start, naming IDM_DATABASE_URL | Any | Yes |
| `ENROLMENT_SIGNING_JWK` | Unset; a secret, never shown | The attester's private JWK, as JSON | **Doesn't start**: Unset or not a JSON JWK: the service does not start, naming it | Any | Yes |
| `APPLE_TEAM_ID` | Unset | The Apple team of the App ID an App Attest attestation must be bound to; with the bundle id, App Attest is on | **Doesn't start**: Set without APPLE_BUNDLE_ID: the service does not start, naming both | Any | Yes |
| `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID` | Unset | The bundle of the App ID an App Attest attestation must be bound to | **Doesn't start**: Set without APPLE_TEAM_ID: the service does not start, naming both | Any | Yes |
| `APPLE_ALLOW_DEVELOPMENT` | `false` | Whether development App Attest objects are accepted, each flagged in the registry, with a warning | **Not checked**: Read leniently: anything but true, in any case, means false | Not in production: `true` | Yes |
| `APPLE_MACOS_REQUIRE_KEY_POLICY` | `true` | Whether a Mac's App Attest key must show Full Security and SIP | **Not checked**: Read leniently: anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | Yes |
| `APPLE_REQUIRE_RENEWAL_ASSERTION` | `true` | Whether an App Attest enrolment renews with an app_attest_assertion | **Not checked**: Read leniently: anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | Yes |
| `CONNECTOR_BUILDS` | Unset; a list | The connector builds accepted, as base64url SHA-256 hashes, comma-separated; unset accepts any build and records it | **Not checked**: Taken as written: a wrong hash refuses that build | Any | Yes |
| `UV_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | `300`; seconds | The oldest a user verification may be at binding; must match the instance-registry-datasource's field | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: the service does not start | Any | Yes |
| `REQUIRE_COMPLIANT_DEVICE` | `true` | Whether a device whose compliance is unknown is refused an attestation | **Not checked**: Read leniently: anything but true, in any case, means false, so a typo turns it off (PR-3) | Not in production: `false` | Yes |
| `PINGONE_ISSUER` | Unset | The PingOne environment that authenticates the user; with the client id, user authentication is on | **Per request**: Unset: every user authentication is refused, with a warning at start | Any | Yes |
| `PINGONE_CLIENT_ID` | Unset | The PingOne client whose ID tokens are accepted | **Per request**: Unset: every user authentication is refused, with a warning at start | Any | Yes |
| `PINGONE_ACR_AAL2` | Unset; a list | The sign-on policy names, comma-separated, whose acr means AAL2; anything else is AAL1 and refused for binding | **Per request**: Empty: every authentication is AAL1 and refused for binding, with a warning at start | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTATION_SUB` | Unset; one of `client_id` | client_id mints the attestation's sub as the registered client, with the instance id as agent_id; unset keeps the instance id as sub | **Doesn't start**: Anything but client_id, exactly: the service does not start, naming it | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_AGENT_CLIENT_ID` | Unset | The registered client minted as sub when OIDF_ATTESTATION_SUB=client_id | **Doesn't start**: Unset with OIDF_ATTESTATION_SUB=client_id: the service does not start, naming it | Any | Yes |
| `YUBICO_PIV_ROOTS` | Unset; a file path | A PEM bundle of pinned Yubico PIV roots; set, yubikey-piv evidence is accepted | **Doesn't start**: A file that cannot be read as PEM certificates: the service does not start | Any | Yes |
| `ALLOW_SELF_ASSERTED_KEYS` | `false` | Whether secure-enclave-self-asserted evidence, a key whose storage nobody can verify, is attested (without a key_storage claim), with a warning | **Not checked**: Read leniently: anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | Yes |
| `AGENT_AUTHORIZATION_DETAILS` | Unset | A JSON array: the RFC 9396 ceiling every connector attestation carries | **Doesn't start**: Not a JSON array of objects: the service does not start | Any | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_ENTITY_ID` | Unset | The federation authority (PingFederate's issuer) that hosts agent entities; unset, none is registered | **Per request**: Wrong: each enrolment's registration with the authority fails | Any | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_URL` | Unset; an http or https URL | Where to reach the authority from here; the entity id when unset | **Per request**: Wrong: each enrolment's registration with the authority fails, and its credentials - a DPoP-bound token and proof, or in development the static bearer - go to whatever host it names | Any | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN` | Unset; a secret, never shown | Development only: the authority's static bearer (OIDF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN there), sent when PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID is unset, with a WARN per enrolment. Production refuses to start with it set, as the authority refuses its static bearer there | **Doesn't start**: Set in production: the service does not start, naming it. Unset in development with the entity id and no PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID: the service does not start, naming the settings to set | Not in production: any value | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_INSECURE_TLS` | `false` | Trusts any certificate on the authority's listener, for development, through platform's InsecureTls; the host name is still checked | **Not checked**: Read leniently: anything but true, in any case, means false | Not in production: `true` | Yes |
| `AGENT_DISPLAY_NAME` | Unset | The display name the authority vouches for about every agent | **Not checked**: Taken as written | Any | No |
| `AGENT_DESCRIPTION` | Unset | The description the authority vouches for about every agent | **Not checked**: Taken as written | Any | No |
| `AGENT_KEYWORDS` | Unset | A JSON array of strings: the keywords the authority vouches for about every agent | **Doesn't start**: Not a JSON array of strings: the service does not start | Any | No |
| `AGENT_MISSION_TYPES` | Unset | A JSON array: the RAR types an agent may claim, an essential subset_of in the authority's statement | **Doesn't start**: Not a JSON array of strings: the service does not start | Any | Yes |
| `AGENT_MISSION_PURPOSES` | Unset | A JSON array: the DPV purposes an agent may pursue, an essential subset_of in the authority's statement | **Doesn't start**: Not a JSON array of strings: the service does not start | Any | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID` | Unset | device-enrolment's client at the authority's PingFederate: it gets an access token by client credentials with the scope oidf.admin.entities, each token request carrying a DPoP proof, and enrols agents with it under the DPoP scheme. Set it with exactly one of PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_JWK and PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_SECRET; in PingFederate the client needs the client credentials grant, the oidf.admin.entities scope and Require DPoP | **Doesn't start**: Set without exactly one of the key and the secret: the service does not start, naming them. Unknown to PingFederate: each enrolment's registration fails with the token endpoint's answer | Any | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_SECRET` | Unset; a secret, never shown | PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID's secret, sent as client_secret_basic (RFC 6749 section 2.3.1); set this or PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_JWK, not both | **Per request**: Wrong: each enrolment's registration fails with the token endpoint's 401 | Any | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_JWK` | Unset; a secret, never shown | PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID's private key as a JWK, for private_key_jwt: each token request carries an assertion it signs (ES256 for an EC key, PS256 for an RSA one, or the key's alg), with the token endpoint as its aud; set this or PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_SECRET, not both | **Doesn't start**: Not a JWK, or no private key: the service does not start, naming it. A key PingFederate does not hold for the client: each registration fails with the token endpoint's 401 | Any | Yes |
| `PF_AUTHORITY_TOKEN_ENDPOINT` | Unset; an http or https URL | The authority's token endpoint, reached from here; <PF_AUTHORITY_URL>/as/token.oauth2 when unset | **Per request**: Wrong: each enrolment's registration fails, and the client's credentials go to whatever host it names | Any | Yes |
